notes.title: Update 1.0.1 & 1.0.2
notes.content:
The first updates have arrived!

Update 1.0.1:
+ New UI in solar system scene
+ New camera controls in solar system scene
+ several bugfixes

Update 1.0.2:
+ New Fuel System:
There is the new body part “engine” that needs fuel to run. Currently, coal is used as fuel, so you need to mine some coal to keep the fuel from running out. Once you run out of fuel, you need to add new fuel to the engine. When you run out of fuel, you have to respawn. When you respawn, you will be teleported back to the surface and given some new fuel for your engine.
+ several bugfixes

What's up next?
Currently, my main focus is on fixing bugs, implementing your feedback and improving the overall quality of the game. However, there will also be updates that add new features to the game. More details will follow soon.

Many thanks to all of you for your support! :)

notes.title: Planet Miners is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
After months of development, Planet Miners has finally been released!
Planet Miners is my first game that I developed on my own and published on Steam. I will continue to update the game over the coming days and weeks. Please let me know what you think and what features you would like to see in the future!
